name: Voice Conversion Challenge Spoofing Benchmark
description: A benchmark for assessing artifacts and spoofing-related quality issues in voice conversion systems, using objective spoofing-countermeasure-based evaluation as an alternative to expensive human listening tests.
evaluation_method: spoofing countermeasure scores; detection error tradeoff / spoofing detection performance
notes: Targets artifact assessment rather than direct naturalness or similarity alone; grounded in anti-spoofing methods from speaker verification.
